answer_1.quote: In this paper, we consider a unsupervised query generation method based on Query Likelihood Model (QLM) , which judges the relevance of each query-document pair independently, thus offering lower time complexity.

answer_2.quote: we compute the conventional Top-K retrieval accuracy, nDCG@K and MAP@K metrics to evaluate the re-ranking performance. And we use the EM and F1 scores for evaluating the QA performance of LLMs.
